title: Genki I: An Integrated Course in Elementary Japanese
japaneseTitle: 初級日本語 げんき I
description: Comprehensive foundational textbook covering JLPT N5 vocabulary, essential grammar structures, and 145 kanji across Lessons 1–12.

title: Genki II: An Integrated Course in Intermediate Japanese
japaneseTitle: 初級日本語 げんき II
description: Upper-elementary Japanese textbook covering JLPT N4 vocabulary, complex grammar constructs (honorifics, passives, causatives), and 172 kanji across Lessons 13–23.

title: Minna no Nihongo I: Main Textbook & Grammar Companion
japaneseTitle: みんなの日本語 初級 I
description: Authentic communicative Japanese textbook covering JLPT N5 vocabulary, sentence patterns (文型・例文), 18-character dialogues (会話・練習C), interactive drills (練習A/B・問題), and kanji across Lessons 1–25.
